significance: The temple picturesquely stands on the bank of the Osmansagar Lake (also known as Gandipet Lake), a major reservoir built on the Musi River. While there is no running river immediately adjacent, the picturesque lake serves as a serene backdrop. Devotees visit the lake area for relaxation, but there is no sacred step-tank (Dharmagundam) for bathing on the immediate temple premises; bathing is not a prerequisite here.
